style: Photoreal cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, colour grade with deep slate-blue shadows and warm amber and brick-red light, no text, no signage, no logos, no faces in focus.

shots.scene: Blue hour over Belfast Lough, two enormous yellow Harland and Wolff gantry cranes silhouetted against a deep slate-blue sky with a last thin band of orange on the horizon, city lights beginning to glow along the water, light mist over the lough.
shots.motion: Slow, steady push-in toward the two cranes. City lights flicker on one by one and mist drifts across the water. Calm and continuous, no cuts.

shots.scene: A narrow wet cobbled street in Belfast's Cathedral Quarter at night, red-brick and stone buildings, warm amber light spilling from old pub windows, a few people in winter coats seen from behind walking toward a glowing doorway at the end of the lane, reflections on the cobbles.
shots.motion: Low, smooth tracking shot following the people from behind as they walk down the lane. A light drizzle glistens in the window light. Continuous, no cuts.

shots.scene: A small queue outside the door of a red-brick Victorian music venue at night, a warm lamp above the door, breath visible in the cold air, a hand held out for an ink stamp, people seen from behind and the side with faces out of focus.
shots.motion: Gentle handheld drift toward the open door as the queue shuffles forward, breath steaming in the cold. Continuous, no cuts.

shots.scene: Inside a packed, hazy small music venue, seen from the back of the crowd between shoulders and raised hands, the stage glowing ahead in brick-red and amber light, haze catching beams of light, everyone facing away from the camera.
shots.motion: Smooth steadicam push forward through the crowd toward the stage. Light beams sweep through the haze and the crowd sways. Continuous, no cuts.

shots.scene: From inside the crowd looking up at the stage, a guitarist backlit in silhouette, warm amber and brick-red stage lights with a soft lens flare, fans' raised hands in the soft-focus foreground.
shots.motion: Slow drift with a rack focus from the raised hands to the guitarist, then the stage lights fade from red and amber down to deep slate blue. Continuous, no cuts.
